title: Agricultural technology categories
description: Technology families relevant to agricultural production, monitoring, decisions and supply chains.
governanceNotes: ARTIFICIAL_INTELLIGENCE classifies the subject matter of reporting. Its presence does not enable AI analysis, automated classification or any AI feature in FlahaINTEL.

terms.label: Precision agriculture
terms.definition: Site-specific management using measured variation to target agricultural actions.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include variable-rate and location-specific production management; exclude general mechanization without site-specific control.

terms.label: Remote sensing
terms.definition: Observation of land, crops or resources using satellite, aerial or other non-contact sensors.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include remotely acquired imagery and measurements; exclude in-field contact sensors.

terms.label: Geographic information systems
terms.definition: Systems for storing, analyzing and visualizing spatial agricultural information.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include spatial-data platforms and analysis; descriptive event locations alone do not constitute GIS modeling.

terms.label: IoT and field sensors
terms.definition: Connected or local sensors measuring field, soil, crop, livestock or environmental conditions.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include deployed sensing devices and telemetry; exclude remote sensing and laboratory-only instruments.

terms.label: Farm-management systems
terms.definition: Software supporting operational planning, records, resources and workflows on farms.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include farm operational management software; exclude systems limited to one analytical recommendation.

terms.label: Decision-support systems
terms.definition: Systems that organize data or models to support agricultural decisions.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include advisory decision support; classification does not itself create or execute a recommendation.

terms.label: Agricultural data platforms
terms.definition: Platforms that integrate, govern or distribute agricultural datasets and information products.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include multi-source agricultural data infrastructure; exclude single-purpose farm record systems.

terms.label: Automation and robotics
terms.definition: Automated machines and robotic systems performing agricultural tasks.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include autonomous or automated field and facility operations; exclude conventional manually operated machinery.

terms.label: Controlled-environment agriculture
terms.definition: Technology controlling environmental conditions for crop production in enclosed or protected systems.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include greenhouses, vertical farms and controlled growth systems; exclude open-field climate-smart practices without environmental enclosure.

terms.label: Agricultural biotechnology
terms.definition: Biological and genomic technologies applied to crops, animals or agricultural inputs.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include breeding biotechnology, biological inputs and agricultural genomics; exclude general medical biotechnology.

terms.label: Irrigation technology
terms.definition: Equipment and control systems for efficient agricultural water delivery.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include irrigation hardware, automation and scheduling technology; exclude water policy without a technical system.

terms.label: Soil-monitoring technology
terms.definition: Tools and systems specifically measuring or assessing soil condition.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include soil sensors, testing platforms and monitoring tools; exclude general agronomic advice without soil measurement.

terms.label: Supply-chain traceability
terms.definition: Technology recording and tracing identity, custody or condition across agricultural supply chains.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include traceability and provenance systems; exclude ordinary logistics systems without traceability capability.

terms.label: Artificial intelligence
terms.definition: Technology offerings explicitly using machine learning or artificial intelligence in agricultural contexts.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include reporting about agricultural AI technology; this descriptive category does not add AI analysis to FlahaINTEL.
